texts.value: Can function as a specific repressor of TGF-beta, activin, and BMP signaling through its interaction with the R-SMAD proteins. Antagonizes TGF-beta-induced cell proliferation arrest
Interacts with SMAD1, SMAD2, SMAD3 and SMAD5. Binds to both phosphorylated and unphosphorylated R-SMADS
Heart, brain, placenta, lung, liver and skeletal muscle

disease.description: A disease characterized by osteopoikilosis and disseminated connective-tissue nevi. Osteopoikilosis is a skeletal dysplasia characterized by a symmetric but unequal distribution of multiple hyperostotic areas in different parts of the skeleton. Elastic-type nevi (juvenile elastoma) and collagen-type nevi (dermatofibrosis lenticularis disseminata) have been described in BOS. Skin or bony lesions can be absent in some family members, whereas other relatives may have both.

texts.value: The disease is caused by variants affecting the gene represented in this entry
